LESSON: FABRIC DECORATION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.2: Fabric Decoration

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Fabric Decoration. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is fabric decoration important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify techniques used to decorate a fabric
2. value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FABRIC DECORATION
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Fabric Decoration helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: FABRIC DECORATION
Study Fabric Decoration like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify techniques used to decorate a fabric

What this means
In this part you learn to identify techniques used to decorate a fabric. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify techniques used to decorate a fabric.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Fabric Decoration” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify techniques used to decorate a fabric. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric

What this means
In this part you learn to value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Fabric Decoration in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Fabric Decoration is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Fabric Decoration” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify techniques used to decorate a fabric)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Fabric Decoration in your own words. (skill: value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Fabric Decoration to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify techniques used to decorate a fabric.
3. Practise this skill: value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Fabric Decoration from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Fabric Decoration: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Fabric Decoration?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is fabric decoration important?
2. What are the sources of natural dyes?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Fabric Decoration means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify techniques used to decorate a fabric.
5. Be able to: value tie and dye and appliqué techniques for decorating a fabric.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
